metadata.title: Pembrolizumab, Paclitaxel 175 mg/m² and Carboplatin AUC 5 Therapy
metadata.short_title: Pembrolizumab, Paclitaxel 175 mg/m² and Carboplatin AUC 5 Therapy
metadata.indication: Persistent, recurrent or metastatic cervical cancer with a PD-L1 combined positive score of at least 1.
metadata.partial_assessment_note: Any independently actionable entered value is assessed; omitted domains remain unassessed and do not block a partial result.
metadata.partial_assessment_policy: Each entered value is assessed independently. Omitted domains remain unassessed and are never assumed normal.

catalogue_reconciliation.scope_note: The NCCP states that its website list is not comprehensive. This reconciliation does not assert that every possible national regimen is published online.

encoding_maturity.label: Encoded protocol · full source coverage review pending
encoding_maturity.scope_note: The protocol has executable SACTCheck content but has not yet completed the v0.68.0 full source fidelity review. Use the current NCCP source as authoritative.

clinical_governance.prescriptive_authority: Treatment plan must be initiated by a Consultant Medical Oncologist or the specialist authority specified in the current NCCP source.
clinical_governance.dose_modification_note: Use the most restrictive applicable component rule and confirm all dose changes against the current official NCCP PDF.
clinical_governance.disclaimer: Decision-support encoding derived from NCCP 00817 Version 2. It does not replace the current official regimen, prescribing review, pharmacy verification or independent clinical judgement.

indications.description: Persistent, recurrent or metastatic cervical cancer with a PD-L1 combined positive score of at least 1.

treatment.schedule_summary: Pembrolizumab, paclitaxel and carboplatin on day 1 every three weeks for 6–8 cycles, according to benefit and tolerability. Pembrolizumab alone every three weeks while it helps and side effects are manageable.

alt_ast_uln_multiple.label: ALT / AST actual result (highest ×ULN calculated automatically)

non_haematological_toxicity_grade.label: Other clinically relevant non-haematological toxicity grade

options.label: Grade 2
options.description: Moderate; intervention may be indicated and instrumental activities may be limited.

options.label: Grade 3
options.description: Severe or medically significant; hospital care may be indicated and self-care may be limited.

non_haematological_toxicity_grade.assessment_guidance: Identify the named toxicity and grade it using the applicable CTCAE term rather than a generic impression.

hypersensitivity_grade.label: Infusion or hypersensitivity reaction grade

options.label: Grade 1
options.description: Mild transient reaction; interruption not indicated.

options.label: Grade 3
options.description: Prolonged or recurrent reaction; hospitalisation indicated.

hypersensitivity_grade.assessment_guidance: Assess timing, treatment required, recurrence and airway or haemodynamic compromise.

gfr_or_crcl_ml_min.label: Measured GFR or protocol-approved CrCl for carboplatin calculation

renal_input.reason: Exact GFR/CrCl is required for Calvert carboplatin dosing.

paclitaxel_neuropathy_grade.label: Paclitaxel peripheral neuropathy grade

options.label: Grade 2
options.description: Moderate symptoms limiting instrumental activities of daily living.

options.label: Grade 3
options.description: Severe symptoms limiting self-care activities of daily living.

paclitaxel_neuropathy_grade.assessment_guidance: Assess sensory/motor symptoms, gait, fine motor function and effect on daily activities.

pneumonitis_grade.label: Immune-mediated pneumonitis grade

options.label: Grade 2
options.description: Moderate; intervention may be indicated and instrumental activities may be limited.

options.label: Grade 3
options.description: Severe or medically significant; hospital care may be indicated and self-care may be limited.

pneumonitis_grade.assessment_guidance: Assess respiratory symptoms, oxygen requirement, imaging and exclude infection.

diarrhoea_colitis_grade.label: Immune-mediated diarrhoea/colitis grade

options.label: Grade 2
options.description: Increase of 4–6 stools/day; limits instrumental activities.

options.label: Grade 3
options.description: Increase of ≥7 stools/day, incontinence or hospitalisation; limits self-care.

diarrhoea_colitis_grade.assessment_guidance: Assess stool frequency above baseline, blood, pain, hydration and systemic features.

rash_grade.label: Immune-mediated rash/dermatitis grade

options.label: Grade 2
options.description: Moderate rash or symptoms limiting instrumental activities.

rash_grade.assessment_guidance: Assess morphology, body-surface area, mucosal involvement and function.

creatinine_ratio_baseline_or_uln.label: Creatinine ratio versus baseline or ULN

cortisol_nmol_l.label: Cortisol (optional; interpret by sample time/steroid exposure)

treatment_visit.label: Treatment being given at this visit

course_neuropathy.label: Neuropathy present at the next cycle

immune_hepatitis_grade.label: Clinician-assessed immune hepatitis grade

options.label: Grade 3
options.description: Severe or medically significant; hospital care may be indicated and self-care may be limited.

immune_hepatitis_grade.assessment_guidance: Enter the clinician-assessed grade for the confirmed immune event and apply the organ-specific laboratory criteria in NCCP Table 3.

immune_nephritis_grade.label: Clinician-assessed immune nephritis grade

options.label: Grade 2

options.label: Grade 3

immune_nephritis_grade.assessment_guidance: Enter the clinician-assessed grade for the confirmed immune event and apply the organ-specific laboratory criteria in NCCP Table 3.

creatinine_uln_multiple.label: Serum creatinine relative to laboratory ULN
